text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Splendid!
Congratulations on passing the qualifiers!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Carrying all the fans' expectations on their shoulders, the Umamusume compete on the grand stage where they can shine their brightest...

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Not to mention the spectators, but look at the thoroughly satisfied expressions on those girls who ran their hearts out!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"Splendid! That is precisely what we have been
looking for in the URA Finals!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Now, next up you'll be competing against the formidable rivals who won the qualifiers—how's your confidence!?
choice_data_list: I promise I will win next time as well!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"Inspiration!
I expect great things from you—bring forth a passionate race!"
